title: Delivery Specialist
description: Join a Winning Team at Arona Home Essentials! Delivery Specialist Looking for more than just a job? Build a career with a company that's been growing for decades. At Arona Home Essentials , we're proud to be an industry leader with over 50 locations across 13 states and Puerto Rico . While other companies slow down during economic changes, we've continued to grow by investing in our people, delivering exceptional customer service, and providing quality products and services that families rely on. We're building a team of dependable, driven people who take pride in their work and are committed to creating outstanding customer experiences. If you enjoy working with people, solving problems, and being part of a team that makes a difference every day, this could be the opportunity for you. At Arona, your success isn't determined by a college degree—it's determined by your work ethic, reliability, leadership, and results . We promote from within and provide the training, support, and opportunities needed to build a rewarding career. Why You'll Love Working Here At Arona Home Essentials , we believe great employees deserve great rewards. We invest in our people and provide opportunities to grow, succeed, and be recognized for your contributions. Here’s what you can expect as part of the Arona team: Unlimited Bonus & Commission Opportunities – Your effort directly impacts your earnings. Five-Day Work Week – Enjoy two days off each week while maintaining a full-time schedule. Paid Time Off – Vacation days, personal days, and paid holidays. Comprehensive Benefits – Medical, Dental, Vision, Short-Term Disability, Company-Paid Life Insurance, and Long-Term Disability. 401(k) with Company Match – Invest in your future. Career Growth & Development – Ongoing training, leadership development, and advancement opportunities with a company that promotes from within. What You'll Do As a Delivery Specialist , you'll be the face of Arona Home Essentials in our customers' homes. You'll play a key role in delivering products, providing exceptional service, and ensuring every customer has a positive experience from start to finish. Your responsibilities will include: Delivering merchandise safely, professionally, and on schedule. Inspecting products before delivery to ensure merchandise is clean, complete, and operating properly. Loading, securing, and protecting products in delivery vehicles. Safely transporting merchandise while following all company safety standards. Unloading, installing, and demonstrating products to ensure customers understand how to use their merchandise. Providing outstanding customer service during every delivery interaction. Performing routine service calls, product exchanges, and assisting with merchandise returns. Cleaning and certifying returned merchandise in the Quality Assurance Center. Assisting with maintaining an organized showroom floor and warehouse. Supporting occasional customer account and collections efforts when needed. Participating in field marketing programs and community outreach efforts. What We're Looking For We're searching for someone who is: Customer-focused and enjoys helping people. Reliable, dependable, and takes pride in completing quality work. Professional and comfortable representing Arona in customers' homes. Mechanically inclined with strong technical skills or experience working with electronic products. A strong communicator who can explain products and provide solutions. Safety-minded with excellent driving habits. Organized and able to manage delivery schedules effectively. Professional in appearance and attitude. At least 18 years old. Able to safely lift, load, and dolly heavy merchandise as part of daily responsibilities. Able to pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check and meet company driving requirements. Bilingual? That's a plus! A valid driver's license, satisfactory driving record, and the ability to pass a pre-employment background check, drug screen, agility test, and DOT physical are required prior to employment. Ready to Grow With Us? If you're looking for more than just a job—if you're ready to build a career where your hard work is recognized, your skills are valued, and your opportunities for advancement are real— Arona Home Essentials is the place for you. Apply today and join a company that invests in its people, rewards performance, and celebrates success. Arona Home Essentials is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.
